decisions.reason: Treating the draft as inspiration only does not negate the independently stated preference for its colours, which is already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event.

The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event already records both the requirement for fresh original ideas and the AI-generated draft's role as inspiration only; no additional state change is required.

The reference material's inspiration-only role does not change the company-name or excluded-word requirements; those separate wording decisions are already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event.
The source explicitly leaves the existing strapline unchanged, and treating the draft as inspiration only does not alter the candidate requirement.
The source clarifies the design reference and colour direction but does not change the independent obligation to supply brand-colour documentation.
The inspiration-only treatment of the draft has no necessary effect on the independent font-guidance deliverable.
